name: Dia
summary: AI web browser for work, with chat across open tabs and a daily brief.
description: Dia is a web browser for macOS and Windows that adds AI chat working across open tabs, a Morning Brief summarising calendar and inbox, and ready-to-share outputs.

howToUse.title: Open Dia
howToUse.description: Download Dia, the browser for macOS and Windows.

howToUse.title: Read the Morning Brief
howToUse.description: Open the Morning Brief summarising the calendar and inbox before the workday starts.

howToUse.title: Ask across tabs and share
howToUse.description: Use the AI chat working across open tabs, then make ready-to-share outputs such as a report or a deck.
